company.name: Munchbox
company.shortDescription: Munchbox is a healthy snack brand offering guilt-free, nutritious snacks, keto products, and wellness-focused food delivery solutions.
company.description: Munchbox is a Dubai-founded healthy food and snack company established in 2014 by Mahmoud Adham. The company focuses on creating convenient, nutritious, and diet-friendly snacks designed for busy professionals and health-conscious consumers. Its product portfolio includes keto breads, protein bars, granola, low-carb pasta, energy balls, vegan snacks, gluten-free foods, and functional wellness products. Munchbox operates through e-commerce, subscription delivery services, retail partnerships, and corporate wellness programs, with products distributed across the UAE and other GCC markets. The brand emphasizes clean ingredients, balanced nutrition, and healthier alternatives to traditional snacking while supporting modern dietary lifestyles such as keto, vegan, and low-sugar eating habits. The company has also expanded its presence through retail distribution, online sales, and regional partnerships, becoming one of the recognized healthy snacking brands in the Middle East wellness food sector.
